title: Recall: Match variants carrying different payloads
summary: Reconstruct complete expressions using the specified reference form. Formatting may vary; alternative implementations belong in Apply. Each clue states its own context because surrounding code is hidden in Recall.

countArm.clue: Matching reading: &Reading for enum Reading { Idle, Count(u32), Named { name: String, value: u32 } }, write the full Count arm binding value and returning the dereferenced integer. Omit the comma.

namedArm.clue: Matching reading: &Reading, write the full Named arm binding only value, ignoring the other field with rest syntax, and returning the dereferenced u32. Omit the comma.
